description: This file defines a class named Gnumeric that extends BaseReader, allowing the application to read and parse Gnumeric spreadsheet files. It includes methods for checking file compatibility, listing worksheet names and info, loading spreadsheets, processing XML content, and handling spreadsheet features such as cell data, styles, merged regions, filters, column and row dimensions, and defined names. The class interacts with other components like Spreadsheet, Worksheet, and various helper classes to facilitate spreadsheet import functionality specific to Gnumeric format.

classes.name: Gnumeric
classes.description: A class for reading and importing Gnumeric spreadsheet files, supporting extraction of worksheet information, data, styles, and other spreadsheet properties, and converting Gnumeric XML content into PHPSpreadsheet objects.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the given file can be read as a Gnumeric file by examining its contents for specific namespace signatures.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns the list of worksheet names from the Gnumeric file without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata about each worksheet such as name, size, and last columns.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates a new Spreadsheet object and loads data from a Gnumeric file into it.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data from a Gnumeric file into an existing Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: gzfileGetContents
methods.description: Reads and decompresses (if needed) the file contents, ensuring security checks.

methods.name: processComments
methods.description: Processes cell comments from the Gnumeric XML structure and adds them to the active sheet.

methods.name: loadCell
methods.description: Loads a cell's value and style from the XML into the active worksheet, handling formulas and data types.
